Kuniya Learning Management System is an online learning platform that helps students access courses, study materials, assignments, quizzes, and other learning resources through a single platform.
Kuniya LMS provides courses and learning programs through the online platform. You can visit the Courses section to view the available courses.

patterns: how can i learn a course
responses: You can open a course from the Courses section to view its details, learning materials, assignments, and other available resources.
To register, open the Registration section and enter your required student details. After completing registration, you can use your login credentials to access the LMS.
To log in, open the Login page and enter your user ID and password. Select the appropriate user type and click Login.
If you forgot your password, use the Forgot Password option on the Login page and follow the instructions to reset your password.

patterns: where can i find study material
responses: You can access available study materials and learning resources from your student dashboard or the Resources section.
Assignments are available through the course or student dashboard. Open the required course, view the assignment, and submit your work according to the instructions provided.
Kuniya LMS can provide online quizzes and MCQ tests as part of a course. Open the relevant course and select the available quiz.
The student dashboard provides access to your courses, learning materials, assignments, quizzes, progress, and other student-related features.
Your course progress can be viewed from the student dashboard when progress tracking is available for the course.
Kuniya LMS supports online learning by providing courses, digital learning materials, assignments, quizzes, and other educational resources through the platform.
The administrator can manage students, courses, instructors, learning resources, announcements, and other LMS activities depending on the available permissions.
Instructors can manage their courses and learning content and may provide study materials, assignments, quizzes, and other learning activities for students.
For help, please use the Contact Us section of the Kuniya Learning Management System or contact your LMS administrator.
You can provide feedback or report an issue through the Contact Us or feedback section available in the LMS.
You are currently using the Kuniya Learning Management System. Use the navigation menu to access courses, services, resources, registration, and other sections.
